title: Relief wagon consequence text promised the first LURE feed's +1 cattle… @ albany_city
excerpts: Relief wagon consequence text promised the first LURE feed's +1 cattle alarm would be skipped, but cattle alarm still rose by 1 on that action.
Relief wagon support text promised to prevent the Exposed Ridge's +1 cattle alarm, but cattle alarm still rose by 1 immediately after descending.
Benefit text implies it prevents the Exposed Ridge cattle-alarm rise, but it only applies to the last LURE feed, causing a minor expectation mismatch.
